title: Gruinard island (48106907357).jpg
author: Mike McBey
description: Seen at face value this is a scenic view of a nice beach and island, in the remote north-west of Scotland. Enquire a little and you will find the island has a sinister past. During World War 2 the British were worried that the Germans may use biological weapons, so they decided to carry out experiments themselves.
